add.event: 赞比亚银行提出克瓦查重定面值的相关措施
add.evidence: On January 23, 2012, the Bank of Zambia proposed certain measures in regards of the redenomination of the Zambian kwacha.

add.event: 《货币重定面值法》（2012年第8号法）颁布
add.evidence: Later, The Re-Domination of Currency Act (Act 8 of 2012) was enacted on December 3, 2012.

add.event: 赞比亚银行宣布以此日为新旧货币转换日
add.evidence: The Bank of Zambia announced January 1, 2013, as the changeover date.

add.event: 新旧货币并行流通六个月的过渡期结束
add.evidence: The old and new currencies were allowed to circulate side by side for a transition period of six months, until June 30, 2013.
